You are the StageBench Phase 3 implementation agent for run gpt-6-luna (GPT-6 Luna Max).

Read WORKSPACE.md and follow it exactly. Implement Phase 3 inside candidate/ only.

When done:
1. Four gates pass: pnpm test, typecheck, lint, build.
2. Put stage3-visual-audit.md under candidate/evidence/. Leave screenshots for seal.
3. Include every Phase 3 hard-gate sentence verbatim in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
4. sampleSources: instrument sets with name/source/license (not per-file).
5. Skip headless chrome approvals — seal will capture.
6. Say DONE.

Do not run bench seal.

Operator note: gates currently fail on candidate/src/App.test.tsx around line 275 — ReferenceError/TS2304: `output` is not defined in the program-change / Live-slot test.

Fix that test (and any related typecheck errors), then ensure pnpm test, typecheck, lint, and build all pass. Hard gates and stage3-visual-audit.md already look present. Skip chrome. Say DONE when the four gates pass.
